# The codes the server owns and the store decodes strictly, under the
# migration version they shipped with: `version set codes...`. Unit
# enums list their stored codes; JSON columns list their schema's variant
# and field names. A set that grows needs a migration with it, so an older
# build opens that database read-only rather than fail on the new code:
# append the new set's lines under the new migration's version. From the
# public beta, a line here is never changed or removed.

17 role member owner unknown viewer
